headline: TSMC posts sixth consecutive record profit but offers cautious outlook
summary: Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing Company posted its sixth straight quarter of record profits driven by AI demand, though its cautious outlook weighed on tech shares.
why: TSMC is the world's largest contract chipmaker, producing advanced semiconductors for global tech giants like Apple and Nvidia.

impacts.name: Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing Company
impacts.why: Strong financial earnings are counterbalanced by cautious forward-looking guidance on future sector demand.

why_moved: While quarterly earnings beat expectations, management's conservative commentary regarding future growth tempered market enthusiasm.
